It's Bad That the Main Character Is a Roleplayer
description: A gamer who has spent countless hours roleplaying suddenly finds himself inside the world of a game. Instead of simply playing a character, he must actually live as the role he created. With his knowledge of the game, an unusual roleplaying mindset, and the dangers of a world that no longer follows the rules he remembers, he must survive while uncovering the truth behind his unexpected transformation.
author: Jin Seolha / Haeseo
